title: 56-bit-VA gated Phase-0 Vandermonde Y-cluster joint-2X 6-window split-word birthday search on secp256k1 at 123.359139432588631 (MX=8)

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold gated grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md on a 56-bit-VA generator/relay/home machine recovers x with unconditional single-run probability at least 0.39 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins (if Q=O, x=0 immediately). One coordinator first draws a 128-bit RNDR coin u and halts with no output unless u < K_GATE = 133025420141064816783379887723529591501 (p_gate = K_GATE/2^128 ~ 0.390926575; GATE = 256 instructions charged on every run); otherwise it runs Phase-0 GF(1024) Vandermonde birthday X-pair mining (E_mine <= 2^125.3432 instructions) and q1 = 70,000,000,000 batches in G = 2048 power-law groups (m_g = floor(q1*(g/2048)^(25/32))) on 2^66 generators (2^56 clusters of 1024, MX=8), 2^41 relays and 2^82 homes (CAP_H = 1,313,229,200,424,960 records). The opened run succeeds with probability lo_run >= 0.998908811125 (swap-free conditional-X Chen-Stein and arrival-order-free singleton/no-singleton pool-superset bounds, success.md 6.1-6.6), with exact rational (K_GATE/2^128) * lo_run >= 0.3905 > 0.39 (checked in c21). Expected total work E_total = 256 + p_gate * E_run is at most 2^123.359139432588631 units of 1000 scalar AArch64 instructions (opened run E_run <= 2^124.714170 units, at most 67.1372 instructions per leaf of S = 2^128.610916). Peak memory at most 2^138.0002 bytes; opened-run preprocessing at most 2^116.2652 units, included in E_run; no advice and no reliance on prior submission verdicts. certificate.py checks the 33-interval VA registry, the 27-cell ledger, the 5.1 itemizations, the rate bounds and the census figures.

experiments.purpose: Checks Y-chain generation, the MX=8 Phase-0 birthday 6-window split-word leaf kernels (TFP4S_7, CORS7, two-BFXIL 169-bit labels, LF3 limb-0 carry folds) against bit-exact models, table builds and mutant rejections (experiment.py, sites.py); the 56-bit-VA K1=64/K2B=128 machine with Y ring, exclusive-monitor wcnt and ydsp wait/dispatch loops, end-to-end Phase-0 xemit/dlvh/hhclr, address trace, completion and mutant rejections (machine.py); the gate; Vandermonde/Chen-Stein and dependent-pair checks; and the kernel counts against certificate.py.
